name: pudi-skills
description: Ishwar's Claude Code plugins: pudi (build less), guardrails (engineering standards), scanner (code-quality toolchain).

plugins.name: pudi
plugins.description: Laziest-solution-that-works skills: the YAGNI ladder, an over-engineering reviewer, a shortcut-debt ledger, and a PRD writer. Ships a PostToolUse hook that warns when an edit makes a Python file measurably more complex.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Personal engineering standards with a PreToolUse hook that mechanically blocks leading-underscore names, __main__ blocks, __all__, and unpinned dependencies across requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, and package.json.

plugins.name: scanner
plugins.description: Code-quality scanner toolchain: add one analyzer behind a design gate, render self-contained report dashboards, and rank risk hotspots from churn and complexity. Ships a PreToolUse hook that blocks network-dependent report HTML and intact credential patterns. Only useful in a repo that has a scanner.
